title: 카톡 말투 읽기: ㅋㅋ, 넵, 마침표 하나의 느낌
objective: You can read short Korean chat messages, tell from small signals (ㅋㅋ, ㅠㅠ, ~, a period) how the sender feels, and choose a suitable reply for a friend or a senior.
summary: This worksheet teaches the abbreviations and tone signals Koreans use in chats, and how texting a friend differs from texting a senior.
note: The chat messages on this sheet copy real casual texting, so short forms like ㅋㅋ and ㅇㅇ are written the way Koreans really type them.

task.title: Read and reply to chats
task.line: Read each chat or message, then answer, choose, fill in, or put the lines in order as the instruction asks.

items.text: Shows laughing; more ㅋ means funnier, and it is for friends and casual chats.
items.example: 어제 그 영상 봤어? 진짜 웃겨 ㅋㅋ

items.text: A gentle smile that softens a message, so it is also OK with people you speak 요 to.
Shows you are sad, sorry, or touched; it makes bad news sound softer.
items.example: 오늘 못 갈 것 같아 ㅠㅠ

items.text: A very short yes for close friends only; it can feel rude to a senior.
A quick casual no between friends.
A casual short form of thanks; never use it with a senior.
A cheerful polite yes, very common in work chats; it sounds softer than 네.
Reading a message and not replying (읽고 씹다); people often feel hurt by it.

sections.heading: Tip: small signs, big feelings
paragraphs: In Korean chats, how you end a message shows your mood. 알았어~ or 넵! feels warm, but 알았어. or 네. with a period can feel cold or even upset, especially to younger people.
With a senior, write full sentences and do not use ㅋㅋ, ㅇㅇ, or ㄱㅅ. Short forms are only for friends.

sections.heading: Texting a senior (teacher, boss): the usual order

steps.en: Greet them and use their title
Say who you are if they may not have your number
Close with thanks or a kind wish

exercises: Read the chat. Around what time will 지수 arrive?: 민수: 내일 7시에 강남역에서 볼까? / 지수: ㅇㅇ 좋아. 근데 나 10분쯤 늦을 것 같아 ㅠㅠ
Write the English meaning of the texting word in each message: ① ㄴㄴ 나 벌써 먹었어. ② 우산 빌려줘서 ㄱㅅㄱㅅ!
Your team leader sends this. Choose the better reply, (a) or (b): 팀장님: 회의 자료는 내일까지 보내 주세요. (a) ㅇㅇ 알겠어 (b) 넵, 내일 오전까지 보내 드리겠습니다.
Put the lines of this message to a professor in the right order: (a) 혹시 내일 오후에 면담이 가능할까요? (b) 안녕하세요, 교수님. (c) 감사합니다. (d) 저는 한국어 수업을 듣는 마리아입니다.
Fill in the blank with one texting word from this worksheet: 친구: 어제 너한테 톡 세 번이나 보냈는데 답이 없더라. 너 나 ____했지?
